main_text.p: מחשבתא מחשכא Chald.& Syr.Cogitatio, ratiocinatio, disceptatio. Plural. מחשבן מחשבתא: ܚܫܒܢ Sine disceptationibus, 1.ad Tim.2.8.
השבני Ch. Chaschbanæi. Respondet Hebraeo זמזמים quomodo Ammonitæ Gigates istius temporis vocabant, Deut.2.20.
חשך Ch. Suspicari, suspectum habere de facto aut delicto aliquo commisso, insimulare, culpare aliquem, Deut.24.9.in T.Jon. Ithpeh. אתחשר Suspectum esse, suspectum haberi, Deut.21.2.in Jon.
חשח Ch. Opus, Necesse habere, Indigere, Necessarium esse, Dan.3.16. Esræ 6.9. Syrè, Utile, Aptum, commodum, accómodatum esse, prodesse.
Ethpah. ܐܬܚܫܚ Uti, In usum suum accommodare, usurpare, Usum, Consuetudinem, Familiaritatem habere cum aliquo, Conversari familiariter.
ܐܚܫܚܘܬܐ Syr. Idem, ad Rom.1.26. ad Col.2.22.

חשך Ch. & Syr. Tenebrosum, Obscurum esse vel fieri, obscurari, obtenebrari: Item Contabescere, Psal.6.8.&31.11. Ithpah. אתחשך Idem. Aph. אחשיך Obscurare. Part. קרב מקריים ומחשיך Veniebat matutinans & vesperascës, i. Mane & Vespere, 1.Sam.17.16,

page.notes: Several Syriac and Hebrew words are rendered approximately; the Syriac type of the entries from "Syr.Utilis" onward, and the Hebrew vocalisation of some entries, are uncertain. The printed Hebrew and Syriac have been reproduced as closely as the scan allows.
